entities.summary: Clement Greenberg, occasionally writing under the pseudonym K. Hardesh, was an American essayist known mainly as an art critic closely associated with American modern art of the mid-20th century and a formalist aesthetician. He is best remembered for his association with the art movement abstract expressionism and the painter Jackson Pollock. Clement Greenberg was a journalists & chroniclers from The Bronx (1909-01-16, The Bronx–1994-05-07). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
